title: Tenure Ceiling on New Tailwise Pharmacy Prescription Diet Orders
content:
*Pals Rewards and Tailwise Plus benefit schedule, member tenure.*

The days' supply per fill of a new Tailwise Pharmacy prescription diet order placed for a pet whose diet another household pet already takes is no more than the tenure ceiling. The tenure ceiling counts the whole calendar months from the Pals Rewards and Tailwise Plus membership's enrollment date — the date the customer first joined Pals Rewards — to the order date, and reads the membership's status.

| Whole calendar months since enrollment | Membership status | Tenure ceiling |
|---|---|---|
| 60 or more | active | the class's maximum days' supply per fill |
| at least 24 but fewer than 60 | active | 45 days: the 30-day new-order days' supply plus 15 days |
| fewer than 24 | any | 30 days |
| any | past due, pending downgrade or closed | 30 days |
| no membership | | 30 days |

## Boundary (hypothetical dates, membership active)

| Enrollment date | Order date | Whole months | Tenure ceiling |
|---|---|---|---|
| 2021-09-10 | 2026-09-10 | 60 | class maximum |
| 2021-09-10 | 2026-09-09 | 59 | 45 days |
| 2024-09-10 | 2026-09-10 | 24 | 45 days |
| 2024-09-10 | 2026-09-09 | 23 | 30 days |
